description:
Get a user's public taste profile — their top notes, accords, and families derived from their cabinet, collections, and reviews. No LLM call, deterministic.

See also: `user_taste_compare` for compatibility between two users.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

username.description: Username (handle) of the user to view

name: user_taste_public
